notes.title: 🦋Update after 7 years
notes.notes:
You didn’t expect it, did you?

With the upcoming console launch, we’ve brought the game back to life — updated, reimagined, ready for a new audience.

Massive Optimization Rework
Everything runs smoother now. Performance, loading, stability — all improved with care.

Engine and Plugin Upgrades
The core of the game has been modernized.
New engine version. Updated plugins. Including Post Processing for a richer atmosphere.

Asian Language Support
Chinese, Japanese, and Korean languages are now supported.
Welcome, new travelers.

We know it’s been a while.
What’s happened in your life since the last time you launched the game?
Let us know. We’re listening again
